name: The Garment Of Praise
overview: Scripture reveals that the 'Garment of Praise' symbolizes a divine exchange where God replaces our spirit of heaviness with joy and righteousness, as seen in Isaiah 61:3. This garment represents the beauty and strength God imparts to His people, calling them to arise in holiness and praise, exemplified by Isaiah 52:1 and Psalms 45:7. The anointing of the Spirit, described in Isaiah 11:2 and Matthew 3:11, equips believers to worship the Father in spirit and truth, embodying the true worshippers Jesus spoke of in John 4:23.
